description: Versioned corpus declarations for the Field Notes source dir at 100, 1000 and 5000 articles. Each source dir is the original archive's apps/, shared/ and scripts/ with scripts/generate.mjs run at that count; the corpus is NOT in this repo.

generator.invocation: node scripts/generate.mjs <count>, cwd = the source dir
generator.semantics: deterministic; argv[2] is the article count (integer 40..100000, default 100); it replaces content/articles, writes content/manifest.json and copies shared/spec.json, shared/site.css and shared/field-grid.svg into apps/{zfb,next,astro}

originalAudit.note: the original benchmark's audit records primary/verification/{0,1,2}/datasetSha256 for 100, 1000 and 5000; each equals the datasetSha256 declared below

archiveDataset.note: the archive's content/ is the 5000-article dataset; the 100 source is generate.mjs 100 (batch Q src-100 is byte-identical to a fresh regeneration, every file under apps, content, scripts and shared)
no 1000-article content tree is in the archive; the dataset hash equals the original audit's 1000 entry

archiveDataset.verifiedBy: diff -rq between the archive's content/ and content/ from generate.mjs 5000: no difference; content tree, dataset and content/manifest.json hashes are equal
archiveDataset.note: the archive's original content/ and the regenerated one are the same bytes, so either can be the 5000 source
